purpose: Define what must be true before the eight scoped validated V2 surfaces may be exposed in runtime, without rewriting the legacy L04 evidence history or promoting lexical/universal grammar authority.

requiredPrePromotionGates.name: Machine-readable V2 runtime manifest
requiredPrePromotionGates.requirement: Create a separate V2 runtime manifest referencing only the eight validated surfaces; do not alter legacy recovered_phrases.

requiredPrePromotionGates.name: Exact allowlist validator
requiredPrePromotionGates.requirement: Reject any generated L04 surface outside the eight-item allowlist, including filler substitution and KE-removal derivations.

requiredPrePromotionGates.name: Authority guard validator
requiredPrePromotionGates.requirement: Assert SALI/SARU/PARAZAMI remain WATCH, DAYI/KE remain CANDIDATE, and ERU/RUMI remain authored-candidate locked; runtime exposure must not mutate authority.

requiredPrePromotionGates.name: Writing/rendering verification
requiredPrePromotionGates.requirement: Verify all eight runtime surfaces resolve through governed G-ID/syllabification/MX1-59/font-cmap v1.1 with zero unresolved.

requiredPrePromotionGates.name: Pedagogical UX contract
requiredPrePromotionGates.requirement: Expose the eight surfaces only in controlled L04 activities whose prompts/readings match their validated scope; do not present the schemas as universal grammar rules.

requiredPrePromotionGates.name: Negative-space regression suite
requiredPrePromotionGates.requirement: Explicitly reject universal ERU/KE, declarative-by-KE-removal, DAYI/SALI complements, SARU=usually, SARU+DAYI/SALI, universal RUMI/copoly/temporal-order inferences.

requiredPrePromotionGates.name: Automated execution evidence
requiredPrePromotionGates.requirement: Run the dedicated L04 V2 validators and record actual PASS/FAIL. Existing repository-wide red baseline must not be reinterpreted as L04 V2 failure without inspecting causes.

requiredPrePromotionGates.name: Human runtime promotion decision
requiredPrePromotionGates.requirement: After RUNTIME-01..07 evidence, require explicit A.S. to change V2 runtime state. This proposal itself cannot activate runtime.

releaseDecision.reason: The language batch and derived writing coverage are scoped and complete, but runtime safety needs a separate machine-readable allowlist, negative-space guards, actual validator execution, and explicit promotion.

humanGate.approvalEffect: Approve this readiness contract and authorize implementation of RUNTIME-01 through RUNTIME-07. Runtime remains HOLD.
humanGate.nextIfApproved: Implement V2 runtime manifest + exact allowlist/authority/writing/negative-space validators and UX exposure contract, then execute dedicated checks and report evidence before a runtime promotion gate.
